name: w13_xeno
_comment: Wave 13 item 3: a guided missile locked on a SAME-govt ship. Kit FF Range: mïsn 1068 (the spaceport offer) puts Kit Xeno Shooter (gövt 344, xenophobic 0x0001, anchored, guided missile with about 210 px reach) on the far mark; mïsn 1069 (Mission BBS job) puts Kit Xeno Victim (the same govt, anchored, shield 1000 without recharge, unarmed) on the near mark, 150 px from it; the player sits at the port, 260 px from the shooter (out of the missile's reach). Does the xenophobe fire at its own govt's ship at all, and does a missile locked on it hit or pass through? Pilot w13_xeno. Tab panels (the victim's shield) every 2 s for about 45 s.
